exceptions.reason: The R console panel was an inert plain text box that invited command entry but did not evaluate input or support history, and exposing a raw R console is outside the GUI meta-analysis workflow.
exceptions.before_behavior: The Results / Analysis window showed a black and green pseudo-console strip below the results with a banner, image variable names, and a >> prompt.
exceptions.after_behavior: The Results / Analysis window shows only the results navigation and result content; the removed vertical space is available to summary text, plots, weights, and references.

exceptions.reason: Editable 2x2 margins made routine raw count corrections over-determined and blocked single-cell edits with an inconsistent-table warning. The redesign keeps raw counts as the editable inputs and treats margins as derived displays.
exceptions.before_behavior: Binary and Diagnostic calculators exposed 2x2 margin totals as editable cells and ran consistency checking during raw-data edits, so changing one raw count could be reverted as an inconsistent table.
exceptions.after_behavior: Binary and Diagnostic calculators keep only the four inner raw-count cells editable during raw-data entry, recompute the displayed margins live, and do not run the 2x2 consistency gate for raw-count edits.

exceptions.reason: The informational note interrupted every fresh-profile diagnostic analysis that selected multiple metric families without providing an actionable choice.
exceptions.before_behavior: Advancing from Diagnostic Metrics with multiple metric families opened an informational note over the Method & Parameters dialog unless the user had opted out through a saved preference.
exceptions.after_behavior: Advancing from Diagnostic Metrics opens the Method & Parameters dialog directly without an informational interstitial or related opt-out preference.
